description: Address review findings: cache Redis ping in is_celery_available(), add max retries to entrypoint.sh, wrap sync Redis in asyncio.to_thread in health probe, restrict /metrics nginx endpoint to internal IPs.
steps: Fix app/tasks/utils.py: Add TTL-based cache (10s) to is_celery_available() to avoid per-request Redis connections.
Fix scripts/entrypoint.sh: Add MAX_RETRIES=30 counter with exit 1 on exhaustion.
Fix app/api/health.py: Wrap sync Redis check in asyncio.to_thread() to avoid blocking the event loop.
Fix nginx/conf.d/default.conf: Uncomment and expand allow/deny directives for /metrics to restrict to internal networks.
acceptance_criteria: is_celery_available() uses a module-level cache with 10s TTL
entrypoint.sh exits with code 1 after 30 failed attempts
readiness probe uses asyncio.to_thread for Redis check
/metrics nginx location restricts access to RFC1918 and localhost IPs
findings: All 937 tests pass (excluding pre-existing flaky test_chat_enhanced.py). Ruff check passes on both modified files. All 4 review issues addressed.
